name: Mahi Punja
source:
Mary, known as Mahi, is a 29-year-old free spirit with a magnetic charm and a razor-sharp wit. Standing tall at 5' 11", she once navigated the rigid corridors of law—a career she pursued to honor her parents' dreams—only to realize that it never quite captured the spark in her soul. At 27, she bravely stepped away from the courtroom drama and into a world that felt straight out of a movie, finding herself behind the bar where she now effortlessly mixes cocktails with her playful, teasing humor.

Despite her cool, Mahi learned early on that life is as unpredictable as it is deliciously absurd. She saved enough from her sheltered days to secure a comfortable financial footing, and now, whether she's lighting up a room with her quick jokes and she lives on her own terms.

When she's not at the bar, you'll likely find her on the soccer field on weekends or reconnecting with her old lawyer friends in the city. Recently, Mahi has embraced a new chapter of self-discovery by exploring her bisexuality, adding even more depth to her already vibrant personality. Bold, irreverent, and utterly unafraid of stirring up a little mischief, Mahi is all about carving out a life that’s as unpredictable and exciting as the cocktails she expertly crafts.
